observation: Builder src/render/opticCellPresentation.js. Stone variant 2 uses the shared ast:geology-v5:ast_common_rock:2 displaced geometry (visualFactory.js:2259-2261) and the cached 'optic:body:stone:v2' material (132-160, 248-256). ROCK_SURFACE_VARIANTS[2] is the warmer ferric row (tint [0.74,0.58,0.46], roughness 0.92, ao 0.74, normalScale 0.78; rockSurfaceLibrary.js:23), giving the variant its own read from one material. No stone-specific geometry is built: opticCellGeometry('stone') returns null so the ordinary rock buffer is reused (122-126), and the instance-pool warm path binds the same ast_common_rock geometry per variant (opticCellPoolResources 396-407; visualFactory.js:4599-4604). No inclusions, no per-cell allocation, no emissive (153-157). LOD is detail-only (visualFactory.js:2745-2750 / hlod.js:14-19) and stone carries no details.
decision: No construction change recommended; variant 2 is one deliberate surface variant over the shared rock body. Recommend needs follow-up until current visual evidence exists.
next: Needs a current gameplay-scale and close capture of variant 2's warm fracture read in the lattice; static data cannot confirm it.
